svg.aria-label: Your agent drives OpenSlop over MCP
svg.title: Your agent drives OpenSlop over MCP
svg.desc: OpenSlop is added to Claude Code as an MCP server and allowed in the browser. A prompt in the terminal makes tool calls that travel over MCP into the open project: a title, then a script of speech, image and video. Generate renders the image and the video.
